# Solid axle height variations and tire fitment

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Measure frame rail height and use spacers or Chevy hubs for solid axle tire fitment. [t1471]

## Parts

- Chevy Hubs and Rotors [t1471]
- Rear Spacers, if keeping Nissan axle [t1471]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] A solid front axle allows clearing large tires like 37s without excessive lift. [t1471]
- Running a Dana 44 with Chevy hubs narrows the track width by about 2 inches compared to stock Ford knuckles. [t1471]
